text: I received a request from the co-owners of Rorschach Brewing Company that they require a resolution from the local Municipal Council in order to obtain a Manufacturer's Limited Liquor Sale licence, which would allow for a "sales by the glass" permit for their brewery 1001 Eastern Avenue.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council support Rorschach Brewing Company's application to the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario for a Manufacturer's Limited Liquor Sales Licence for sales by the glass at its manufacturing site located at 1001 Eastern Avenue.
